messages:
rebecca: Heads up: billing team flagged ~8k traces with owner=null after yesterday's enrichment surge. Looks like compaction raced async enrichment.

noah: do we have a small repro? any logs?

rebecca: sample log: `2026-04-02T03:11:02Z WARN compactor: merged span trace=03F2G, owner=none; enricher async queued`

devin: current default = eager compaction + async enrich. Options: delay compaction, sync lookup on missing owner, or tag merged rows and backfill.

kai: prefer tagging + async backfill: less impact to tail latency. Add `provenance=late_enrich` and `provenance_version`. Analytics must be able to dedupe.

noah: need circuit-breaker too: when enrich queue depth or latency spikes, switch compactor into "hold-and-retry" mode so we avoid producing nulls en masse.

rebecca: config proto:
```
compaction:
  mode: opportunistic
  hold_ms: 2000
  late_provenance_tag: "late_enrich"
  backfill_qps_limit: 1500
```

devin: metrics to add: `compactor.late_tag_count`, `compactor.pending_backfill`, and `enrich.queue_depth`. Alert if pending_backfill > 10k for 10m.

kai: ops runbook snippet: if pending_backfill high -> raise `backfill_qps_limit` temporarily, increase `enrich_cache_ttl`, or enable `hold-and-retry` cluster-wide.

infra-bot: staging toggle applied to compactor-canary at 2026-04-02T05:00:00Z. Monitoring enabled.

rebecca: I'll draft RFC with cost model (estimate token delta when backfill engages), sample reconciliation queries, and migration notes. Posting link soon.

noah: +1. also include how billing export will include `provenance` so downstream chargeback jobs can handle late attribution.

devin: sounds good. short canary for 24h then iterate.

kai: thumbs up.

infra-bot: note: if `compactor.pending_backfill` > 5000 for >30m, runbook triggers pager.
